question: Which functions in src/ directly call `upsert_edge`?
result_text:

|---|---|---|

The IBWD MCP tools weren't available in this session, so I used Grep instead of `ibwd_callers`. I matched the hits to their enclosing functions by line ranges from the `def` lines. I read the `rebuild_reference_edges` body to confirm its call isn't inside the nested `add_edge` helper.

The grep for `upsert_edge` only matches by name. If it were called under an alias or through `getattr`, it wouldn't show up. The other hits are the imports at `resolution.py:25` and `queries.py:9`.
